summary: The Backrooms is a shared multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, Levels 1–6, Base Gamma and an isolated debug room. Authored cells and place simulations assemble the spaces; shared player, combat, NPC, loot and UI systems support scavenging, fighting, building, trade and dialogue, with progression and inventory saved per player.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, containers, breakable furniture, shifting walls, smilers and lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, agents, loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, supplies, NPCs, hounds, sludge and damaging steam vents.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze/crawl halls, hazards, lore set pieces, creature brigades and Gamma checkpoint; generators and lifts connect deeper levels.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards, residents and locked Database terminal.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; offices, fountains, break-room vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega; sim lays residents and office systems/tasks.

places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel; Main Hall, guest rooms, Beverly Room and Boiler Room; residents, Housekeeping, rentals, elevators, mahjong and Level 6 east threshold; x0z0 has the entrance and explorer's drop box.
places/level6 (3D) - Lights Out; sim-generated seeded, tight concrete hall tree with chalk notes, blocked dead end, stairwell back to Level 5 and occasional whispers; halls are pitch-dark.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, player actions, template and HUD renderer, including elevator floor-list action.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain: locomotion precedes movement; interaction/gameplay handlers run before critter and view3 handlers.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position, computer/seated/death views, talk close-up and third-person view.

places/<place>/sim.js - place setup/tick roots; simulations assemble geometry, residents, encounters and exits; Level 4/5 also lay place systems, Level 6 lays its concrete plan once and ticks local sounds.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; Level 3 objects.scene hosts visits and Level 5 x0z0.scene hosts hotel fixtures/managers, threshold bulb and drop box.
scripts/ui.js and *-ui.js renderers - HUD and overlays for transitions, loot, talk, build, stats, craft, OS, horde, lockpick, mahjong and elevator floors.
scripts/view3.js - player-chain input handler maps held thirdPerson to player.state.tp; scripts/camera.js consumes it.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/stats-ui.js - K opens the HALOGEN attribute/skill sheet; stats.js owns its state and spending.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + Level 0 data, scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with data - per-level grids/layouts reused by sims, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + Level 3 data + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim, creatures and visits.
scripts/lib/level4.js, scripts/lib/level5.js and scripts/lib/level6.js - office/hotel plans and sanity data plus Level 6 seeded hall grid shared by geometry/simulation and player place behavior.
scripts/lib/l5-hall-layout.js + l5-hall-kit.js and scripts/lib/l5-boiler-plan.js - hotel furnishing/door plan and boiler coordinates shared by geometry and active lay/heat scripts.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml; scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - place NPC definitions, rounds, speech, resident spawning and simulation helpers.
scripts/lib/npc-life.js + npc-lore.yml, scripts/lib/voices.js + scripts/lib/hear.js - shared NPC traits and spatial voice/speech path used by dialogue, barks and residents.
scripts/lib/hunt.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - Level 0 hunters share hearing, pack-alert, light-visibility and last-sighting/lead calculations.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; Level 4/5 also export lay; places/gamma/sim.js exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.

scripts/lib/level2.js - grid/layout queries and deterministic sludge sites; scripts/lib/level4.js and level5.js - plan constants and queries; level6.js - W/H/C/HT/SEED/START, cx/cz, plan, wallRuns and NOTES.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js - PEOPLE5, roundsOf, speak, spawnResident, tickPeople; scripts/l5-elevator.js - destIndex, ears, update.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - clothing/look/roll helpers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - critter model/look/morph/baseBones helpers; scripts/lib/seat.js - seat claims/sit/stand.
scripts/lib/npc-life.js - lifeOf and fear/want data; scripts/lib/voices.js - throatOf, vo; scripts/lib/npc-talk.js - dialogue config, prompts, parsing and checks.
scripts/lib/mahjong.js - tile/rule, fan scoring, shanten and call helpers; scripts/lib/hunt.js - hearing/alert/sighting helpers; scripts/meg-agent.js - nerveOf, onSpawn, bark, update, vanish.

scripts/lib/ballistics.js - G, prof, spreadDeg, fire, show; scripts/lib/stats.js - attributes/skills, handling, derived stats, carry/armor and NPC stat helpers; scripts/lib/loot.js - spawnAlmond, spawnWeapon, spawnAmmo, spawnShells, POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate, spawnRemains.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/weapon condition, hunger/thirst, cents, visits, kills/deaths and combat; publishes recent loud actions for hunters; owns nvg/nvgOn and battery use.

scripts/stats.js - player.state HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates sheet and spends points; handling() derives weapon penalties from requirements.
scripts/craft.js - player.state craftOpen/craftBench and payout redemption; recipes validate skill/materials; craft also owns hunger/thirst drain and food/water use.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing and spawned creatures carry owner horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.

scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - focus/loot/interaction and player sit state; scripts/lockpick.js owns player.state pick/pickP/pickR, bobby pins and boiler-pick timestamp; seats own occupancy.

scripts/talk.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - dialogue, social memory and NPC follow state; meg-agent owns routines, nerve, arm loadout, combat, fear/want reactions, cover and corpse inspections; active companions can be downed and recovered.

scripts/mahjong.js + Level 5 table state - player.state.mj, cents paid/won and session mjLive; table owns mjGuests roster/solo play/travel lifecycle; Level 6 sim owns place.state.builtV for its one-time hall layout.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered handlers: locomotion precedes movement; interact, grab, rest, mahjong, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, OS, lockpick and horde process before critter and view3 handlers.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; player/enemy gaze and targeting read camera; talkWith, seats and sit state alter view. view3.js writes player.state.tp → camera.js shoulder view, raycasting and camera-local weapon presentation.

Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; paired thresholds connect Levels 1–3; Level 3 lifts → Levels 4/5, Level 4 stairs → Level 5, Level 5 Boiler Room east door → Level 6; Level 6 stairwell returns to Level 5.

scripts/level-door.js trigger → paired arrival marker IDs (PAIR) or state.to fallback; Level 5 l5-to-l6 and Level 6 l6-back use state.to; place sims place inbound markers and player.js selects safe spawn/door checkpoints after death.
scripts/player.js writes state.xfer → scripts/ui.js transition card; player.js gain() writes xpPop → UI aggregates XP, while lvlPrompt prompts K and stats.js clears it when opening the sheet.

interact.js E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js submits choices/text/trade → talk.js/NPC ears; talk.js parses join intent into NPC state.follow; npc-talk.js builds lore/memory-informed prompts and replies update rapport.

Following NPC state.follow → meg-agent.js pursuit/return and companion recovery; player.js ignores hits on an active companion; hotel faction followers can acquire foes and fight back. meg-agent.js reads meg.yml for combat tuning.

Harlan's resident card option → scripts/l5-resident.js checks Speech 25 and writes player.state.l5boilerKey; interact.js targets the parented boiler panel and routes E; l5-door.js also opens it for a following Harlan or from boiler side.

player.js ranged attack → lib/ballistics.js fire() traces bullets from the eye, returning target hits/headshots or first world impact; player.js applies damage and show() emits tracers/impact FX; weapons.yml supplies projectile parameters.
scripts/lib/loot.js place-specific pools and item rolls → interact.js containers and player.js kill drops; Level 3 has special rolls, and NVG loot is in the Level 5 table, not Level 2.
scripts/player.js writes state.loud on swings/shots → scripts/lib/hunt.js uses fight/gunshot radius as well as movement noise to locate prey.
interact.js E on usable l5 elevator panel → player.state.elevPanel; ui.js renders clickable floors → interact.js elevdo emits ui:fN/ui:yes/ui:no to panel; panel scripts handle the selected floor.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state; Level 5 x0z0.scene groups hotel detail by room tags and places the Level 6 entrance and drop box.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office structure, non-colliding detail, varied props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - repeated open-floor cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambience, tasks and rewards.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - agent/resident rounds and talk vary by faction, role, voice, look/build and routine; meg-agent.js adds deterministic nerve and arm loadout.
scripts/smilers.js and lurkers.js use lib/hunt.js hearing and lost-trail prediction but keep distinct light/gaze, pursuit and attacks; hounds, stealers and deathmoths have distinct pursuit behavior.

scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/lib/data/meg.yml - shared NPC combat/follow controller varies by faction, arm, nerve and target; armed agents, Housekeeping and followers fight reachable hall creatures and inspect eligible corpses.

scripts/mahjong.js + mahjong.yml + mahjong-looks.yml - shared game lifecycle and rules vary among six guests by persona, suit preference, species/look, dialogue and call/sloppiness; l5-ball.js handles solo continuation and guest cleanup.

scripts/l5-hall-lay.js + l5-hall-geo.js/l5-hall-fix.js - Main Hall furnishings/fixtures derive from layout rows; hotel elevator banks vary geometry; grab.js shares lift/throw/break behavior across eligible props; Level 6 sim lays its seeded hall plan.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m (hub cells 26–29); Level 1 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4 64×64 m with 8 m offices; Level 5 96×60 m, x ±48/z ±30; Level 6 is 27×41 cells at 1.8 m, 2.4 m high.

Level 6 has no working flashlight: player.js suppresses the toggle and destroys any carried torch on arrival. An owned nvg token enables F to spawn a local camera-attached green light there; it uses the shared battery at 1.5× torch drain.

NPC corpse inspection sets state.inspectUntil so creature controllers defer corpse cleanup; only eligible hostile bodies are inspected and rat corpses are explicitly skipped. meg-agent target acquisition uses recent line-of-sight.

Level 0 weapons no longer replenish as loose pickups; find weapons in desks, cabinets, backpacks or containers. Lobby Wafers use token lobby_wafer. NVGs are rolled by the Level 5 loot table only (removed from Level 2); the owned nvg token powers Level 6's local green light.

Weapon kinds/variants are centralized in weapons.yml/lib/weapons.js; pools restrict new weapons by place via loot.js poolOf/rollWeapon. Keep req {h, guns|melee}, mv/drag/acc/zero, tube/reload timing and two-hand offsets in sync with stats and weapon handling.

First-person weapon meshes are camera-local: player.js uses Q_ID for pistol muzzle-forward orientation, Q_GUN for other gun mesh orientation and measured weapon-specific sight/trigger offsets; bump vm arm cache version when changing attachments.
